_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your NAS details. config.local.json is git-ignored so your password never gets committed. Every field can also be supplied via environment variables (SYNOLOGY_HOST, SYNOLOGY_PORT, SYNOLOGY_HTTPS, SYNOLOGY_USERNAME, SYNOLOGY_PASSWORD, SYNOLOGY_OTP_CODE, SYNOLOGY_VERIFY_SSL, SYNOLOGY_TIMEOUT), which override the file.
